Messages.Author: Megakannon
Messages.Body:
Eye of Blades protects from Retainer strikes or all strikes in general. My play group says just the retainer strikes and I am fairly certain they are right, however I have this nag in my brain that says it may cover all strikes.

> Eyes of Blades
> Combat
> Auspex & Celerity
> Do not replace until your untap phase.
> Strike: dodge, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage from a retainer.
> Only usable before range is determined. This round, this vampire cannot strike, and strikes and damage from retainers have no effect on this vampire and any non-retainer cards on him or her.
>

Messages.Author: ruiza97
Messages.Body:
I've also read it as strikes AND damage from retainers as retainers don't strike. Their damage is environmental damage, right?

Messages.Body:
> Megakannon wrote:
> Eye of Blades protects from Retainer strikes or all strikes in general.

Is that a question, without question mark?
Anyway, Eye of Blades protect from
- strikes
- damage dealt by retainers (they don't strike)

> During the initial strike resolution each round, the Ghoul Retainer inflicts 1 damage or may use a weapon not used by the employing minion (or another retainer) that round (either before or after). This is not a strike, although it does count as "using" the weapon.
